hero.eyebrow: We don't just create things. We create experiences!
hero.headline: Creative Solutions For Growing Businesses
hero.subheadline: We are a multidisciplinary creative space for Design, Fabrication, Print, Software Development, Digital Solutions and 3D printing. Our mission is to build innovative experiences, products and visual solutions with precision and purpose.

whyEnvejo.title: In-house Fabrication
whyEnvejo.desc: Laser cutter, 3D printer, Cricut, sublimation printer and badge maker. We make what we design.

whyEnvejo.title: 24–48 Hour Turnaround
whyEnvejo.desc: Rush orders welcome. Standard print and digital orders delivered within 24 hours.

whyEnvejo.title: End-to-End Solutions
whyEnvejo.desc: From logo and brand identity to printed materials, décor, packaging and website — one partner for everything.

whyEnvejo.title: Chennai-Local Pricing
whyEnvejo.desc: Premium quality at prices that work for local businesses, schools and entrepreneurs.

processSteps.title: Discovery Call
processSteps.desc: A free 30-minute consultation where we understand your business, goals, audience and vision. No charge, no commitment.

processSteps.title: Quote & Brief
processSteps.desc: We send a detailed quote within 4 hours. On approval, we collect 50% advance and create a detailed creative brief.

processSteps.title: Design & Create
processSteps.desc: Our team gets to work. You receive the first draft within the agreed timeline, with progress updates via WhatsApp.

processSteps.title: Revise & Refine
processSteps.desc: You review and give feedback. We revise until you're happy — your package's revision rounds are fully used.

processSteps.title: Deliver & Launch
processSteps.desc: Final files, printed materials or fabricated products delivered. Balance payment collected. Post-delivery support included.

footer.description: Design, fabrication, print, digital and education services — all under one roof in Guduvancherry, Chennai.
